Independent, PrintFarmer-authored generated text; not copied or adapted OrcaSlicer source code. It reconstructs the ordered per-band M104/M109 nozzle-temperature setpoint sequence that OrcaSlicer's own temperature-tower calibration (approvedSources id orcaslicer-v2.4.2; see src/libslic3r/calib.cpp and src/slic3r/Utils/CalibUtils.cpp Calib_Temp_Tower at that pinned commit) is documented to emit for its default sweep. No OrcaSlicer binary or GUI execution path exists in this environment (verified: no vendored engine under src/Slicers/**, no headless slicing entry point), so this is not a byte-for-byte capture of a live OrcaSlicer slice; only the per-band temperature setpoint sequence is asserted, and full toolpath/geometry parity is an explicitly unverified gap flagged for reviewer awareness per issue #1926.
